title: Claude's Max 20x plan is now Ultra, at the same $200 price
friendlyTitle: Claude's most expensive personal plan is now called Ultra, at the same price
summary: Anthropic has renamed the Max 20x plan to Ultra. Existing subscribers move over automatically, and the price stays $200 a month. Ultra includes 10 times the Pro plan's usage each week. Verified accounts have no five-hour limit. Accounts that are not yet verified still have a temporary session limit until Anthropic verifies them from account and payment history.
friendlySummary: Anthropic renamed the Max 20x plan to Ultra. If you already pay for it, you move to Ultra automatically, and the price stays $200 a month. Ultra includes 10 times as much weekly use as the Pro plan. If Anthropic has verified your account, there is no five-hour limit. If it has not, a temporary session limit still applies until verification happens on its own.
whyItMatters: The weekly cap remains, including a separate weekly limit for Fable, and Anthropic says it may add other caps. The check is in Settings, then Usage: if there is no Current session bar, the account is verified. Confirming a phone number at checkout does not remove the session limit. Max, at $100 a month, is still the 5x plan. Ultra also includes $200 a month in API credits, up from $100 on Max.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A weekly limit still applies, and there is a separate weekly limit for the Fable model. Anthropic also says it may add other caps. To check, open Settings, then Usage. If you do not see a Current session bar, your account is verified. Confirming a phone number at checkout does not remove the session limit. The $100 Max plan is still the smaller 5x plan.
